selection: Independent audits of all 11200 pilot executions recommend BLEND_T. BLEND_B retained a 48 percentage-point RITUAL weak-append penalty and is not confirmed. Pilot outcomes are not pooled into fresh estimates.
formula: Same frozen BLEND_T: p_i=H_i*D_i; Q=sum(H_i)*sum(D_i); T=max_k k*k*p_desc(k); F=Q/2+min(T,Q)/2; discount=F/Q. Same exact solo/uniform/zero/finite/ULP policies. Original NPC Q, factories, constants, multiplication order, combat and inputs unchanged.
productionScope: User requested checked project first. No production implementation, target rebuild, database, release activation, enhancement-curve change, commit or push.
casesReferTo: Frozen pilot inputs.json original case IDs and group IDs, with full exact members preserved

allocations.purpose: paired direct improvement over unchanged current weak-append target; solo is exactly shared
actual ordinary MAIN base/normal/weak, MID/STRONG, levels20/25
confirmed actual eight-person base and weak append at level30
six real weapon/body stripping guards paired with original full weak-append cases
four numerically identical counter-type twins at N3/N4

seedPolicy: SHA256(namespace+'/'+groupId+'/'+pair), first48bits big-endian. Same roots across compared rules/variants. Fresh namespaces, disjoint from pilot. NPC namespace recorded but unused: no FIXED_NPC conditions in confirmation.
samplingUnit: Mean win score of two freshly constructed mirrored executions, WIN=1/DRAW=.5/LOSS=0. Pair contrasts retain shared random streams. TIMEOUT is explicit, not LOSS; report incomplete pairs and do not claim confirmation for an affected comparison.

primaryFamily.interval: Simultaneous two-sided95percent Hoeffding: every paired difference has support[-1,1], halfwidth=sqrt(2*ln(2*K/alpha)/n), clipped to[-1,1]. Shared exact solo cancels from improvement, so this is NOT a four-score difference with support[-2,2].
primaryFamily.projectCriteria: Lower bounds of the three candidate weak deltas, four ordinary normal-append deltas and N8 weak delta must exceed -.20; lower bounds of all three direct candidate-current improvements must exceed0. These are risk-specific project checks, not a universal monotonic-ally rule or 50/50 target. Failure is reported as negative or inconclusive, with no formula/sample adjustment.

secondaryFamily.interval: Same simultaneous two-sided95percent Hoeffding with K20 and each comparison's frozen n. This secondary family is separate from primary; no joint95percent claim across both families or all game content.
secondaryFamily.interpretation: Stripping upper<+.20 excludes a large advantage only in six tested strips, not every item exploit. Both extreme counter contrasts lower>0 support preserved useful type choice; the eight individual contrasts are reported even when uncertain, not forced to all be equal or individually significant. Weak-vs-normal contrasts quantify a known cost of the correction, with no invented universal dominance rule; repeated large weak preference is explicitly disclosed as a project tradeoff, not hidden by stripping tests.

knownPilotCosts: Ordinary heterogeneous groups become easier in absolute terms; pilot MID25 base32to80percent and STRONG25 base58to84percent. Do not call this unchanged difficulty.
A weak ally can outperform the ordinary fourth fighter under this matching; disclose fresh contrasts rather than claiming only removal of a penalty.
Large-group and upper-level guards remain descriptive25-pair pilot evidence. This confirmation does not certify the whole level progression or all participant counts.
Mass additions may still reduce win rate and some skill/geometry/counter-specific disadvantages remain; no claim that every ally always helps.
prebattleRequirement: Freeze separate confirmation helper/source inputs/prepared samples/manifest/seeds and this policy before execution; independent read-only preflight ACK required. Do not modify frozen pilot artifacts.
stopping: Exactly one run of these80000 executions. No extension, seed replacement, coefficient adjustment, third candidate, extra level search or pooling with pilot after outcomes. Last substantive work is independent raw/result review; show project to user before any15.5 implementation.
